requirement_text:
Organisation: Apollo Hospitals
Segment: Healthcare — Patient Engagement

AI SUGGESTED & EDITED PARAMETERS:
TOOLS AND TECH STACKS: Python, Rasa, TensorFlow, Node.js, AWS Cloud Services for scalable deployment
KNOWLEDGE BASE SOURCES: Clinical guidelines, Internal medical manuals, Previous patient inquiries, Evidence-based practices
SUPPORTED LANGUAGES: English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu
PERSONA AND TONE: Empathetic, supportive, professional, approachable
FALLBACK MECHANISMS: Transfer to live agent, emergency service dial-out, alternative self-service resources
LLM FOUNDATION MODEL: GPT-4o, BERT, with fine-tuning for healthcare applications
EXPECTED OUTCOME: Achieve a 40% reduction in call center volume, maintain a patient satisfaction score of 4.2 or higher, and report zero clinical safety incidents attributable to chatbot advice
REGULATORY CONSTRAINTS: HIPAA compliance, prohibition of diagnostic claims, mandatory clinical audit logging, adherence to local healthcare regulations
USER AUTHENTICATION: Secure user authentication to protect patient data and personalize user interactions
